intro.uz: Bu — internet-doʻkonga yozilgan rasmiy shikoyat xati. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: buyurtmangiz kechiksa, nima qilasiz?

paragraphs.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about order number 40215, which I placed on your website on 3 September. I ordered a wooden desk and a chair for my son, who has just started secondary school. When I paid for the order, the website said that it would be delivered within five working days.

Unfortunately, the delivery did not arrive on time. I have contacted your customer service twice by phone. The first time, I was told that the desk was still in the warehouse and would be sent the next day. The second time, nobody could tell me where my order was. I waited at home for two whole days, but no one came.

The desk finally arrived on 21 September, almost three weeks after I had placed the order. However, when I opened the box, I found that one of the legs was broken, and the chair was missing. As a result, my son has had to do his homework at the kitchen table for almost a month.

I have been a customer of your shop for three years, and until now I have always been satisfied with your service. That is why this experience has been so disappointing. I understand that delays can happen, but I would have expected someone to inform me about the problem.

I would therefore be grateful if you could replace the broken desk and send the missing chair as soon as possible. I would also like a partial refund of the delivery fee, as the service was clearly not what I had paid for. I have attached photos of the damaged desk and a copy of my receipt.
I look forward to hearing from you within seven days. If I do not receive a reply, I will have to take further action. Yours faithfully, Nodira Karimova

title.uz: Oʻzlashtirma gap: said that it would …

grammar.example: the website said that it would be delivered within five working days
I have contacted your customer service twice by phone.

questions.statement: The writer placed the order by phone.

explain.uz: Buyurtma saytda berilgan: «an order that I placed on your website». Telefon orqali faqat mijozlar xizmatiga qoʻngʻiroq qilgan.

questions.statement: The writer contacted customer service more than once.

explain.uz: «I have contacted your customer service twice by phone» — ikki marta.

questions.statement: The delivery driver apologised when the desk arrived.

explain.uz: Haydovchi uzr soʻragani yoki soʻramagani haqida matnda hech narsa yoʻq.

questions.statement: The writer has bought things from this shop before.

explain.uz: «I have been a customer of your shop for three years» — uch yildan beri xaridor.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the letter?
options: to complain and ask the company to solve the problem
to thank the company for its service

explain.uz: Xat «I am writing to complain» bilan boshlanadi va 5-xatboshida aniq talablar bor: almashtirish, stulni yuborish, pulni qaytarish.

questions.prompt: What does the writer say about delays?
options: They can happen, but the company should have told her.
They are always the fault of the driver.

explain.uz: «I understand that delays can happen, but I would have expected someone to inform me» — kechikish boʻlishi mumkin, lekin xabar berish kerak edi.

questions.prompt: In paragraph 5, a «partial refund» means getting …

explain.uz: «partial» — qisman. Muallif faqat yetkazib berish haqining bir qismini qaytarishni soʻraydi: «a partial refund of the delivery fee».

questions.prompt: The writer has attached photos of the damaged desk and a copy of her ___.

explain.uz: «a copy of my receipt» — chekning nusxasi.

questions.prompt: The writer expects a reply within ___.

explain.uz: «I look forward to hearing from you within seven days.»
